cards.text: Friend, this is John, and God is showing him a vision. A trumpet just sounded in heaven, and now a great sign appears there: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head. And I thought MY chef's hat was a big look.

cards.question: This woman clothed in the sun isn't just standing there shining. What's happening to her?

answers.text: She's leading an army of angels

cards.question: The woman is crying out in the pain of giving birth. Then a second sign appears in heaven. What is it?

cards.text: This dragon has seven heads, ten horns and seven royal crowns on his heads. Seven heads. SEVEN. I've got one head, and it can't even remember where I set the timer.

cards.question: The dragon's tail sweeps every last star out of the sky.

cards.text: His tail sweeps a third of the stars from the sky and hurls them to the earth. Then the dragon goes and stands right in front of the woman, who's about to give birth.

cards.question: Why is the huge red dragon standing in front of the woman who's about to give birth?

answers.text: To devour her child as soon as it's born
To snatch the crown off her head
To steal the moon from under her feet

cards.text: Then she gives birth to a son, a male child, “who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” And baker, the dragon is right there. Waiting.

cards.question: The dragon gets to the woman's newborn son before anyone can stop him.
Her son is caught up to God and to His throne. Then the woman flees into the wilderness, to a place ___ had prepared for her.

cards.text: There she'll be nourished for 1,260 days. Somebody prepared a PLACE for her, baker, and back in my drawer days, nobody prepared anything for me but dust.
Then a war breaks out in heaven. Michael the archangel (Jude 1:9) and his angels fight against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fight back.

cards.question: The dragon and his angels win the war in heaven.

cards.text: The dragon isn't strong enough, and there's no place left in heaven for him and his angels. EVICTED, baker, and I thought getting slid to the back of a junk drawer was a demotion.

cards.question: The great dragon is hurled down, and now John tells us exactly who this dragon is. Who is he?

answers.text: The ancient serpent called the devil

cards.text: The devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He's hurled to the earth, and his angels go down with him.
The dragon's just been thrown down, and John hears a loud voice in heaven. It says the salvation, the power and the kingdom of our God have come, and the authority of His Christ, right NOW.

cards.question: Why does the loud voice in heaven say all of this has come now?

answers.text: The accuser of our brothers is thrown down
The woman has come back from the wilderness
The dragon has surrendered his crowns

cards.text: This accuser accused them day and night before our God. Day AND night, baker, I've seen folks hold a grudge, but this guy worked the night shift on it.

cards.question: The voice says the brothers have conquered the accuser. How did they do it?

answers.text: By the blood of the Lamb and their testimony
By their own strength and their swords
By hiding until the accuser got tired

cards.text: And they didn't love their lives so much that they'd shy away from death. Friend, I went quiet in a drawer over a NEW cookie stamper, and these folks didn't shy away from death.

cards.question: Since the accuser has been thrown down, the voice calls on the heavens and everyone who dwells in them to ___.
The voice says woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to them with great fury.

cards.text: And the devil knows he has only a short time. So when the dragon sees he's been thrown to the earth, he goes after somebody.

cards.question: Once he's thrown to the earth, the dragon pursues the woman who gave birth to the son.
The dragon is coming after the woman. How does she get away?

answers.text: She's given two wings of a great eagle
She hides in a cave beside the sea
An angel carries her off on a cloud

cards.text: She flies to her place in the wilderness, where she's nourished for a time, and times, and half a time. The dragon is chasing somebody with EAGLE WINGS, baker, and I once lost a race to a chocolate chip rolling off the counter.
So the serpent tries something else. From his mouth he spews water like a river, to sweep her away in the torrent.

cards.question: A river from the serpent's mouth is rushing at the woman. What stops it?

answers.text: The earth opens up and swallows it
The sun dries it all up

cards.question: Enraged at the woman, the dragon goes back up to heaven to fight Michael again.

cards.text: Instead, the dragon goes to make war with the rest of her children. They're the ones who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
Then the dragon stands on the shore of the sea. And that's where we'll leave him for now, friend, because trust me, this vision is NOT done.

findings.problem: The opening card says 'A trumpet just sounded in heaven.' That fact comes from outside the passage (Revelation 11:15), but the card gives no reference for it. The card cites only Revelation 12:1.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: The core action in the verse is accusing someone day and night. The joke compares it to holding a grudge, which is a different action (keeping resentment, not accusing), so the comparison doesn't match.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: The right answer ('By the blood of the Lamb and their testimony') sounds much more like the Bible than the wrong answers. 'By hiding until the accuser got tired' sounds casual and close to silly. The right answer stands out.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

findings.problem: 'And the devil knows he has only a short time. So when the dragon sees he's been thrown to the earth, he goes after somebody.' The 'So' makes the devil's short time the reason he pursues the woman. Verses 12 and 13 don't connect the two that way. Verse 13 just begins 'And when the dragon saw...'

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The line saying the story isn't over ('And that's where we'll leave him for now, friend, because trust me, this vision is NOT done.') is almost word for word the doc's example ('And that's where we'll leave it for now. Trust me, friend, this story's not done.'), not a new line.

rule.text: The examples show the idea. Write your own line each time.
